prompts.garden:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape puzzle reward artwork for a cozy, vivid fantasy pinball adventure game. This is a complete picture revealed gradually in tiles after levels.
Primary request: Create a beautiful mysterious glowing botanical garden with a winding golden lantern path leading toward an ancient friendly stone gate. Rich lush ferns, oversized flowers, jewel green foliage, magical glowing fireflies, curved stone architecture, hidden inviting details, and warm golden light draw the player deeper into this beautiful garden.
Style/medium: polished high quality hand-painted 3D storybook game key art; richly textured and dimensional, detailed expressive surfaces, vibrant luminous color, rounded charming forms. Avoid flat vector graphics and muted washouts.
Composition/framing: 1536 x 1024 landscape illustration, continuous scene, broad readable masses with lovely small discoveries all across the composition. Clear winding path, gate in middle distance, foreground foliage frames scene naturally. No empty area reserved for UI.
Lighting/mood: enchantingly cozy, curious, joyful, welcoming. Brilliant warm lantern glow against cool teal and emerald foliage. High visual contrast while retaining soft inviting magic.
Constraints: Full bleed image, no text, no letters, no logos, no borders, no watermarks. No UI, no buttons, no menus, no peg board, no game balls, no people. Not scary.
prompts.coast:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape chapter puzzle reward artwork for a cozy, vivid fantasy pinball adventure game. This is a complete picture revealed gradually in tiles after levels.
Primary request: Create an enchanting moonlit sparkling cove with a friendly storybook lighthouse, a winding golden lantern path following the shore, glowing turquoise water, gentle surf, luminous tide pools and charming rounded cliff formations. Warm light glows in the lighthouse windows and lanterns, beckoning the player onward. The garden adventure has led to this magical seaside discovery.
Style/medium: polished high quality hand-painted 3D storybook game key art; richly textured dimensional forms, detailed surfaces, vibrant luminous color, expressive lighting, rounded inviting architecture. Avoid flat vector graphics and muted washed-out palettes.
Composition/framing: 1536 x 1024 landscape continuous scene, broad readable shoreline shapes, lighthouse in middle distance, golden path winds from foreground to lighthouse, scene contains beautiful small discoveries throughout the full frame. No empty space reserved for UI.
Lighting/mood: cozy, joyful discovery under a vivid blue violet moonlit sky. Rich turquoise seas and purple shadows contrast brilliant golden lanterns. The cove feels welcoming, calm and magical, not lonely or ominous.
Constraints: Full bleed image, no text, letters, logos, borders, watermarks. No UI, buttons, menus, game pegs, game balls, or people.
prompts.night:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape finale puzzle reward artwork for a cozy, vivid fantasy pinball adventure game. A magnificent final picture celebrates all earlier chapter discoveries.
Primary request: Create a wondrous hilltop observatory with a friendly rounded glowing dome, open welcoming stone doors, a golden lantern path rising toward it, and many warm glowing floating lanterns rising into a magical night sky full of brilliant jewel stars. The garden and sparkling sea are faintly visible in the valleys below, uniting the full journey in one joyful discovery. A magnificent sky and welcoming observatory are the heroes of the picture.
Style/medium: polished high quality hand-painted 3D storybook game key art; richly textured, dimensional, detailed luminous surfaces, vibrant fantasy colors, rounded charming architecture. Avoid flat vector artwork and muddy muted colors.
Composition/framing: 1536 x 1024 landscape continuous scene, observatory on a gentle hill in middle distance, curved stone and golden path lead from foreground into scene, starry sky and floating lanterns create a magical celebratory sweep. Beautiful details throughout, no empty space reserved for UI.
Lighting/mood: warmly triumphant, deeply cozy, joyful and full of wonder. Rich luminous cobalt and violet night sky against warm gold windows and lanterns, vivid teal landscape accents. Bright dimensional game art with strong contrast.
Constraints: Full bleed artwork; no text, letters, logos, borders, watermarks. No UI, buttons, menus, game balls or peg board. No people. Not scary or ominous.
